row.question:
Based on the chest X-ray in Figure 2, which of the following findings is most consistent with the patient's clinical history of high voltage electrical injury?
A) Large pleural effusion in the right lung base
B) Area of consolidation in the right upper lobe near the hilum
C) Diffuse bilateral lung infiltrates
D) Left lung mass with spiculated margins
E) Cardiomegaly with right-sided pleural thickening
F) Pneumothorax on the left side

reference.correct_choice_text: Area of consolidation in the right upper lobe near the hilum

reflection_candidates.json.limitation: May miss small pneumothorax if overpenetrated or obscured by surgical hardware; requires comparison with prior films

reflection_candidates.json.limitation: Fails if poor inspiration or overpenetration masks volume loss; does not differentiate mucus plugging from tumor/foreign body without clinical data
